lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: وَٱلنَّٰشِطَٰتِ is in the derivative form: نَاشِطَاتٌ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ن/ش/ط   n–sh–ṭ a well with water high enough to draw, to draw water from such a well; energy, agility, to recover completely from illness; to pasture well, (of animals) to migrate from 1 location to another in search of pasture.

Of this root, 2 forms occur 1 time each in the Qur’an:
نَشْطٌ nashṭ and نَاشِطَاتٌ nāshiṭāt.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
نَاشِطَاتٌ nāshiṭāt [pl. of fem. act. part. نَاشِطَة nāshiṭatun] one acting briskly, energetically

(79:1–2) والنَّازِعاتِ غَرْقًا وَالنَّاشِطَاتِ نَشْطًا by those pulling out forcefully and energetically gaining strength.
